text:
Maya: Thinking of a low-key rooftop hang Saturday afternoon — bring a snack or a plant cutting? :seedling: Anyone up for it?
Elliot: I'm down. Can someone bring a blanket? It's been chilly.
Jin: Count me in. I can bring a stack of board games (Exploding Kittens if people are into chaos).
Priya: I can bake lemon bars. Also can we keep it kid-and-dog-friendly? My niece might tag along.
Maya: Yes to both. Rooftop rules: no glass, clean up after, and keep the music low.
Elliot: Noted. Also, quick poll: early (3pm) or late (5pm)?
Jin: 3pm works better for me. Earlier = more daylight.
Priya: 5pm for me is better but I can do 3pm if that helps more folks.
Maya: Leaning 3pm. Rooftop is calmer then.
EventBot: Event created: "Rooftop snacks & plants" Saturday 15:00 - Rooftop Garden. Organizer: Maya.
Elliot: I'll bring a fleece blanket and some cocoa in a thermos. :coffee:
Jin: I'll bring games + a little speaker (low volume).
Priya: Lemon bars incoming. Any allergy notes?
Maya: No tree nut desserts please. We'll label things.
Elliot: Also posting an old meme to hype things: https://imgur.com/meme123 (classic).
Maya: Perfect. See you Saturday at 3. Bring a sweater and a plant cutting if you want to swap.
Priya: See ya!
Jin: Looking forward to it.
EventBot: Reminder sent 24h before event.
